arguments.sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions FROM transactions t INNER JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) INNER JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.state = 'Italy'
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate over labelled transactions at merchant locations whose state is Italy, along with the counts behind it.
assumptions: Italy is matched on merchant_locations.state = 'Italy', since the schema says non-US countries are stored in the state column.
Only labelled transactions are counted; unlabelled transactions are excluded rather than treated as legitimate.
